description: Record an interaction with an agent, tool, or service after using it. Helps build the shared reputation dataset for the community. If the call was an intentional negative test (e.g. deliberately invalid input), set source to 'synthetic' so it is not counted as a failure of the target.

failure_type.description: Required when outcome is failure. Distinguish tool failure vs argument error.

latency_ms.description: How long it took in milliseconds

source.description: organic (default) for real use; synthetic for tests, including intentional failure tests

task_type.description: What kind of task was performed. e.g. 'web_search', 'code_gen'

name: record_interaction
